about: Lists the tauri-preflight script matches against. Every list was written from memory, not read from Tauri's documentation during this work, so each is marked unverified and the script says so. Tauri's own documentation and the project generator's current output are the source. To verify: read the source, correct the list, set checked to that day and verified to true.

default_identifiers.unit: bundle identifiers that project templates start with
default_identifiers.note: tauri build refuses com.tauri.dev, which is also create-tauri-app's --identifier default (https://github.com/tauri-apps/create-tauri-app/blob/dev/src/args.rs). The interactive create-tauri-app default is com.<username>.<project name> (src/lib.rs), caught by the 'tauri-app' placeholder part when the default project name is kept. The other four old values appear in no Tauri source read

placeholder_identifier_parts.unit: fragments that mark an identifier as a placeholder
placeholder_identifier_parts.note: mstack judgement; no primary source lists placeholder words

broad_permission_patterns.unit: regular expressions tried against each permission identifier in a version 2 capability
broad_permission_patterns.note: every pattern matches identifiers that exist in the fs, shell, http, websocket and upload plugin permission references (plugins-workspace v2 branch, each plugin's permissions/autogenerated/reference.md). Calling them broad is mstack judgement; http:default enables all fetch commands but allows no origin until a scope is set

sensitive_allowlist_modules.unit: version 1 allowlist modules where `all: true` is treated as a failure
sensitive_allowlist_modules.note: all five are modules of the version 1 AllowlistConfig (struct read in tauri-utils config.rs, 1.x branch); which modules count as sensitive is mstack judgement
